name: eigenwort-film
description: The README film and screenshots, rendered from simulator recordings.

scripts.film: remotion render Film out/eigenwort.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 && remotion render FilmPortrait out/eigenwort-portrait.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.stills: remotion still ShotToday ../../docs/screenshots/today.png && remotion still ShotTypography ../../docs/screenshots/typography.png && remotion still ShotMagazines ../../docs/screenshots/magazines.png && pngquant --quality=70-92 --speed 1 --force --ext .png ../../docs/screenshots/today.png ../../docs/screenshots/typography.png ../../docs/screenshots/magazines.png && oxipng -o 4 --strip safe -q ../../docs/screenshots/today.png ../../docs/screenshots/typography.png ../../docs/screenshots/magazines.png
scripts.store: remotion still StoreToday out/store/6.9/1-today.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still StoreTypography out/store/6.9/2-set.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still StoreNearby out/store/6.9/3-nearby.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still StoreMagazines out/store/6.9/4-magazines.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store63Today out/store/6.3/1-today.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store63Typography out/store/6.3/2-set.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store63Nearby out/store/6.3/3-nearby.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store63Magazines out/store/6.3/4-magazines.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store65Today out/store/6.5/1-today.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store65Typography out/store/6.5/2-set.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store65Nearby out/store/6.5/3-nearby.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95 && remotion still Store65Magazines out/store/6.5/4-magazines.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=95
